152
Har du intet rum för Jesus,
0:00 / —
SV EN FR AR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

Hast thou no room for Jesus, Who His life for thee laid down? He now knocks upon thy heart: Dear soul, open unto Me!

C.

Room for the Lord of glory, O, open, bid Him in! Blessedness He with Him bringeth, Yea, His glory shall be thine.

2.

Room for pleasures, room for the world, Yea, for all vanity, But no room for Jesus only, He who for thee death endured?

3.

Hast thou no time for Jesus, When in grace He calleth thee? Woe to thee, for He perchance No more will let Himself be heard!

4.

Room and time now give to Jesus, Soon the day of grace is past. If thou thrustest grace from thee, O, how shall thy end then be?

Text: Efter Have You Any Room for Jesus? av Daniel W. Whittle, 1878. Musik: Have You Any Room for Jesus av C. C. Williams, 1878. 8.7.8.7 (8.7.8.7)
